description: FK to Corp Bond Industry Dimension
etl_logic: LOOKUP corp_bond_industry_dim ON corp_bond_industry_dim.industry_code = public_company.business_line_level_1_code, trong đó public_company nối từ mã TP: security_trading_snapshot bond_snpst WHERE bond_snpst.stock_tp_code = '1' AND NOT (bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^[A-Za-z]{2}GB' OR bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^(TD|TP|CP|QH|KB|BL)' OR bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^(HCM|HAN)') JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = SUBSTR(bond_snpst.symbol, 1, 3) [dedup: bond_snpst = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_snpst.symbol ORDER BY bond_snpst.trading_time DESC) = 1]

description: Tổng dư nợ trái phiếu theo ngành TCPH tại ngày t
etl_logic: SUM(listed_share_info.listed_share_quantity * 100000) GROUP BY public_company.business_line_level_1_code FROM security_trading_snapshot bond_snpst JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'HNX_LISTED_SECURITIES_LIST' AND listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = bond_snpst.symbol AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = bond_snpst.trading_dt JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = SUBSTR(bond_snpst.symbol, 1, 3) WHERE bond_snpst.stock_tp_code = '1' AND NOT (bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^[A-Za-z]{2}GB' OR bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^(TD|TP|CP|QH|KB|BL)' OR bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^(HCM|HAN)') AND bond_snpst.trading_dt = :etl_date [dedup: bond_snpst = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_snpst.symbol ORDER BY bond_snpst.trading_time DESC) = 1]

description: Dư nợ trái phiếu toàn thị trường tại ngày t (mọi mã TP lọc theo loại, kể cả mã chưa khớp được ngành; mẫu số Tỷ trọng)
etl_logic: SUM(listed_share_info.listed_share_quantity * 100000) FROM security_trading_snapshot bond_snpst JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'HNX_LISTED_SECURITIES_LIST' AND listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = bond_snpst.symbol AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = bond_snpst.trading_dt WHERE bond_snpst.stock_tp_code = '1' AND NOT (bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^[A-Za-z]{2}GB' OR bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^(TD|TP|CP|QH|KB|BL)' OR bond_snpst.symbol RLIKE '^(HCM|HAN)') AND bond_snpst.trading_dt = :etl_date [dedup: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_snpst.symbol ORDER BY bond_snpst.trading_time DESC) = 1] — tổng toàn bộ mã TP theo SQL BA Nhóm 20 (du_no_toan_tt), KHÔNG nối public_company/ngành; mọi dòng ngành cùng ngày mang cùng giá trị
